moments.author: Sean Duffy
moments.quote: We’ve got to get off old network, old telecom — aging infrastructure caused the FAA ground stop.
moments.why: He’s pinpointing failing legacy infrastructure as the cause of a rare nationwide ground stop—striking a nerve amid widespread travel chaos.

moments.author: Markwayne Mullin
moments.quote: No cyberattack involved—this was just overloaded, outdated systems.
moments.why: He pushed back on cyber‑threat theories and framed public fears around the FAA outage in purely technical terms.

moments.author: AP News (via coverage)
moments.quote: FAA issued a rare nationwide ground stop—communications failures across air traffic control centers.
moments.why: A broad news summary of the incident’s cause and scope, shared rapidly and trending across X.
